fields.description: The app whose navigation this section is part of. Two apps on one site never see each other's sections. Required, and no framework patch backfills it: this DocType is unreleased and was renamed into place without one, so no site holds sections that predate the field. An app that seeded its own earlier backfills those itself.
fields.label: App

fields.description: Empty means the section is app-level — navigation for the app itself rather than for one doctype's sidebar.
fields.label: Reference Doctype

fields.description: Empty means the section is shared with everyone.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The shared section this personal overlay reorders and hides views for.
fields.label: Overrides

fields.description: Where this section sits in the sidebar. Ties break on creation. On an overlay, where its owner moved the shared section — 0 means they never did and it follows the shared order.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: Whether the section's owner has hidden it from their own sidebar. Personal only: a shared section is hidden through its overlay, never on the shared record.
fields.label: Hidden
